info.title: Simbaa API
info.description: API reference for mobile and system integrations.

get.summary: Get active customisation catalog items by type
get.description: Returns active setup catalog items for the selected customisation type. Use this for post-booking food, cake, decor, add-on and other options. Items are returned from the global active setup catalog, not restricted to package-included items.

data.name: Chocolate Truffle Cake
data.description: Chocolate cake with custom size options.

get.description: When slot_start and slot_end are supplied, checks whether that custom time range is available for the selected branch and date. Times must be 30-minute increments and within the branch operating hours. Without slot_start and slot_end, this endpoint keeps returning legacy slot calendar data.

parameters.name: slot_start
parameters.description: Custom start time in 30-minute increments within branch operating hours.

parameters.name: slot_end
parameters.description: Custom end time in 30-minute increments within branch operating hours.

post.description: Creates a new booking with custom start and end time. slot_start and slot_end must be 30-minute increments, within the selected branch operating hours, and must not overlap another active booking for the same branch and date.

parent_id.description: Optional parent ID for admins creating on behalf of parents

slot_start.description: Custom start time in 30-minute increments within branch operating hours.

slot_end.description: Custom end time in 30-minute increments within branch operating hours.

pax_count.description: Total PAX. If adult and child counts are provided, this is recalculated by the server.

gst_amount.description: Optional client-side preview value; recalculated by the server.

total_amount.description: Optional client-side preview value; recalculated by the server.

balance_due.description: Optional client-side preview value; recalculated by the server.

patch.description: Updates booking details with a custom start and end time. slot_start and slot_end must be 30-minute increments, within the selected branch operating hours, and must not overlap another active booking for the same branch and date.

slot_start.description: Custom start time in 30-minute increments within branch operating hours.

slot_end.description: Custom end time in 30-minute increments within branch operating hours.

pax_count.description: Total PAX. If adult and child counts are provided, this is recalculated by the server.

gst_amount.description: Optional client-side preview value; recalculated by the server.

total_amount.description: Optional client-side preview value; recalculated by the server.

balance_due.description: Optional client-side preview value; recalculated by the server.

post.description: Admin-only confirmation step. Moves a newly created unconfirmed booking to confirmed and keeps the deposit status unpaid.

post.summary: Create Razorpay order for booking payment
post.description: Creates or reuses a pending Razorpay order for the booking balance due. Android should use the checkout payload to open Razorpay Checkout.

post.summary: Verify Razorpay payment and confirm booking
post.description: Verifies Razorpay signature from Android Checkout. On success, records the payment and confirms the booking.

message.example: Payment verified and booking confirmed successfully.

post.summary: Update child pass guardian verification status
post.description: Marks the pass generated for a child as guardian verified.
Adds a post-booking food, cake, decor or add-on item and returns the recalculated booking breakdown.

delete.description: Removes a manually added post-booking customisation and returns the recalculated booking breakdown. Package-included customisations cannot be removed.

patch.description: Updates a post-booking customisation item and returns the recalculated booking breakdown.

post.description: Checks whether a customer exists for the provided phone number, stores a generated six-digit OTP, and dispatches it through the configured delivery channel.

message.example: Customer not found for the provided phone number.

post.description: Verifies the customer login OTP and returns a Sanctum bearer token when valid.

post.summary: Login customer with phone and password
post.description: Authenticates a customer using phone and password and returns a Sanctum bearer token.

422.description: Validation failed or credentials are invalid

post.summary: Register a customer by phone and OTP
post.description: Creates a parent guardian and linked customer profile, then returns a Sanctum bearer token.

422.description: Validation failed or OTP is invalid

get.description: Returns the customer profile, including the parent guardian and children data linked to the parent.

403.description: Forbidden (You may only access your own profile)

get.description: Returns vendors with authorization rules based on the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a vendor profile for the authenticated user. Admins may create for any vendor.

message.example: You may only view your own vendor profile.
You may only delete your own vendor profile.
You may only update your own vendor profile.

get.description: Returns vendor service listings with optional filters.

post.description: Logs in a user using email and password and returns a Sanctum token.
